# commercetools Documentation

All the resources to manage and scale your modern commerce experience.

## When to use this

Use the commercetools documentation when you need authoritative, current information about commercetools products, for example to:

- Build or debug integrations with the commercetools HTTP APIs (REST and GraphQL): resource representations, update actions, query predicates, errors, scopes, and limits.
- Import data, build Connect applications, implement Checkout, or develop with Frontend Development and Frontend Studio.
- Configure and operate a Project in the Merchant Center.
- Find out what changed in a product through the release notes.
- Learn commercetools concepts through learning paths, tutorials, and guides.

The documentation describes how commercetools behaves. It cannot read or change the data in a commercetools Project. To work with Project data, use [Commerce MCP](/dev-tooling/mcp/commerce-mcp.md) instead.

For programmatic access, connect to the [Knowledge MCP](/dev-tooling/mcp/knowledge-mcp.md) server at `https://docs.commercetools.com/apis/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no authentication, rate limited). Its tools search the documentation, fetch entries by content ID, return GraphQL and OpenAPI schemas, and validate GraphQL and REST requests before you send them. Without MCP, append `.md` to any documentation URL, send `Accept: text/markdown`, or start from [Search documentation and API specs](/search.md).
